amendment: FWER approval evaluation: Monte Carlo precision
timing: Adopted AFTER the 5,000-repetition extended decision was blocked and AFTER the unofficial 50,000-repetition diagnostic had been seen, and BEFORE any main-study run. It is a procedural amendment made with knowledge of those results, not a rule that was pre-registered from the start; it is not applied retroactively and the earlier reports stay as they are.
reason: With 5,000 repetitions the Wilson 95% upper bound of a true 0.05 rate is about 0.056, and the decision takes the maximum over 34 null rows per N, so a bound of 0.06 is exceeded by Monte Carlo noise alone with probability about 0.99 (plan section 7.5). The criterion then measures simulation noise rather than Type I error. Raising the repetitions to 50,000 (Wilson half-width about 0.002) lets the unchanged 0.06 bound test the error rate itself.
unchanged: FWER approval bound 0.06 (maximum Wilson 95% upper bound over every null row of the decision envelope)
test: two planned contrasts, two-sided paired t, Holm at 0.05; conservative power = raw p < .025 at a 20% effect
power criterion >= 0.80 (Wilson lower bound, minimum over the envelope), power rows reused from the 5,000-repetition grid
decision envelope (latent rho 0, both families, censoring up to the grid ceiling, CVs up to the grid edge at the pilot bound)
N selection and budget rule (flystudy.budget.choose_design: largest passing N within 1.25 x GPU and calendar hours; auxiliary release order)
changed: FWER evaluation repetitions fixed at 50,000 per null scenario (was 5,000)

null rows come from one official CPU run: scripts/fwer_official_verification.py, 108 scenarios (9 CVs x 3 censoring x 2 families x 2 targets, rho 0, effect 0), N 20..100, seeds 29401 + scenario index, no retry with other seeds or repetitions

known_before_adoption.expectation_stated_by_operator: N = 80 (800 runs) is expected but not imposed; the rule selects N

if_passed: select N by the existing rule, write configs/protocol-v5.1-main-N<N>.json (main_seeds 30001.. only), freeze, reserve, run the main campaign
if_failed: report the concrete blocking rows and stop; no further review, no GPU pilots, no re-run with other seeds or repetitions
